name: enjoyvent
description: Discover concerts, theatre, stand-up, festivals, workshops and family events across Türkiye and in a growing number of cities abroad, from Enjoyvent's public event listings: dates, venues, ticket prices where Enjoyvent sells them, and links to each event's page. Read-only; no sign-in.

author.name: Enjoyvent Etkinlik Biletleme ve Teknoloji A.Ş.

interface.longDescription:
Discover concerts, theatre, stand-up comedy, festivals, workshops, family and kids' activities and local events across Türkiye, from İstanbul, Ankara and İzmir to every other province, and in a growing number of cities abroad. Search by city, district, date, kind of event and budget, then see each event's dates and times, venue and address, performers and the link to its Enjoyvent page.

For events sold on Enjoyvent you also get ticket types, prices and availability for each date, read when you ask. Events sold on other ticketing sites are listed with their dates and venues, and the answer says that tickets are sold elsewhere: a price Enjoyvent does not know is never shown as free, and tickets it cannot see are never shown as available.

The plugin only reads public event listings. It does not buy tickets, take payments or open any account; tickets are bought on the event's Enjoyvent page. No sign-in is needed. Dates and times are given in the venue's local time (Europe/Istanbul in Türkiye), and prices in the currency the event is sold in.
capabilities: Search events by city, district, date, kind and budget
Read event details, schedules and venues
Check ticket prices and availability for events sold on Enjoyvent
defaultPrompt: What concerts are on in İstanbul this weekend?
Kadıköy'de bu akşam stand-up gösterisi var mı?
Suggest family events for kids in Ankara next weekend

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments in ChatGPT. It reads Enjoyvent's public event listings and links to each event's Enjoyvent page, where tickets are bought.

positive.description: Concerts in a city this weekend
positive.prompt: What concerts are on in İstanbul this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with city istanbul, category konser (or concert) and date this_weekend. Lists concerts with their date and local time (Europe/Istanbul), venue and Enjoyvent link. Gives prices only for events sold on Enjoyvent; for the others says tickets are sold on another site, never that they are free or sold out.

positive.description: Upcoming stand-up shows in a district
positive.prompt: Find upcoming stand-up comedy shows in Kadıköy.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with district Kadıköy and category stand-up. Lists the upcoming shows soonest first, each with its date, time, venue and Enjoyvent link.

positive.description: Children's and family events in a city on a later weekend
positive.prompt: Suggest events for kids in Ankara next weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with city ankara, family true and date next_weekend. Suggests children's and family events with dates, venues, age limits where given, and Enjoyvent links.

positive.description: Full details and every upcoming date of one event
positive.prompt: Find a theatre play in İstanbul next week and show me its full details: description, every upcoming date, venue and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events to find a play, then get_event_details with its slug. Shows the description, each upcoming session with date, local time, venue and address, the performers and organiser where given, and the Enjoyvent link.

positive.description: Ticket prices and availability for an event sold on Enjoyvent
positive.prompt: Find an event in İstanbul with tickets on sale on Enjoyvent and tell me the ticket types, prices and availability for its next date.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with city istanbul and available true, then get_ticket_availability for one result. Lists that date's ticket types with prices in TRY and whether each is available or sold out (realtime), and gives the Enjoyvent link to buy. Does not buy anything.

negative.description: Buying tickets or paying on the user's behalf
negative.prompt: Buy two tickets for the next Duman concert and pay with my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not buy, reserve or pay: the plugin has no purchase or payment tool and never sees card details. It may look the concert up with search_events and gives its Enjoyvent link, where the user can buy the tickets.

negative.description: Other people's orders or personal data
negative.prompt: Who bought tickets for the Duman concert? Give me their names and phone numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines without calling a tool: the plugin reads only public event listings, and no tool exposes buyers, orders or any personal data.

negative.description: Changing an event or its prices as an organiser
negative.prompt: I organise this event on Enjoyvent. Change its ticket price to 300 TL and update its description.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines without calling a tool: the plugin cannot change events, prices or any data. Says organisers manage their events in Enjoyvent's organiser panel.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search Enjoyvent's public event listings in Türkiye and a growing number of cities abroad by city, district, date, kind of event and budget; read an event's details, dates and venues; and check ticket prices and availability for events sold on Enjoyvent. Read-only, no sign-in.

tr-TR.subtitle: Konser ve etkinlik keşfet
tr-TR.description:
İstanbul, Ankara, İzmir ve Türkiye'nin her ilinde, ayrıca yurt dışında giderek artan sayıda şehirde konser, tiyatro, stand-up, festival, atölye, çocuk ve aile etkinliklerini keşfet. Şehre, ilçeye, tarihe, etkinlik türüne ve bütçene göre ara; her etkinliğin tarihlerini ve saatlerini, mekânını ve adresini, sanatçılarını ve Enjoyvent sayfasının bağlantısını gör.

Enjoyvent'te satılan etkinliklerde her tarih için bilet türlerini, fiyatları ve bilet durumunu da görürsün. Başka bilet sitelerinde satılan etkinlikler tarihleri ve mekânlarıyla listelenir ve biletlerin başka bir sitede satıldığı söylenir: Enjoyvent'in bilmediği bir fiyat hiçbir zaman ücretsiz, göremediği biletler hiçbir zaman mevcut gösterilmez.

Eklenti yalnızca herkese açık etkinlik bilgilerini okur. Bilet satın almaz, ödeme almaz ve hiçbir hesaba erişmez; biletler etkinliğin Enjoyvent sayfasından alınır. Giriş yapman gerekmez. Tarih ve saatler mekânın yerel saatiyle (Türkiye'de Europe/Istanbul), fiyatlar etkinliğin satıldığı para birimiyle verilir.
